Maya P: Jersey Roulette for halftime: everyone pick a jersey color, if winning team's primary color matches your pick you get a free coffee from the winner. Low stakes, high morale. :coffee:
Liam H: I'm picking teal because it's a great neutral pick. 
Diego V: Red, obviously. Also, who wants to join the fantasy playoff quick swap? I need a kicker.
Kara N: Teal is cursed. I'm going bold with yellow. Also snacks: do we want pretzels or empanadas?
Maya P: Poll: jerseys - teal, red, yellow, blue. Snacks - pretzels, empanadas. Reply with both.
OpsBot: FYI: Office fridge has free cold brew. (automated note)
Liam H: Teal + empanadas. Also I'm taking Diego's kicker if he insists on trading for my bench QB. :sweat_smile:
Diego V: Deal if you also throw in your emergency hot sauce packet.
Kara N: Yellow + pretzels. Also chanting practice at 2:03pm for maximum effect. :megaphone:
Maya P: Current tally: teal 2, red 1, yellow 1. Empanadas 2, pretzels 1. Anyone else?
Liam H: Adding a veto on teal chants during work hours.
Maya P: Fine print: coffee winner buys next round of empanadas. Stakes now very real. :eyes:
